question: Which statement is true regarding the IMS Multimedia Telephony service? [3GPP Release 17]
options: It is limited to only including speech as a media component.
It supports real-time video and file transfer.
It does not include supplementary services.
It can only be used for point-to-point communication.
correct_answer: It supports real-time video and file transfer.

question: What is the definition of a cipher key?
options: A logical association between several users
The modulated waveform conveying the physical channels
The combined losses of all transmission system components
A code used in conjunction with a security algorithm to encode and decode data
A link between the card and the external world
correct_answer: A code used in conjunction with a security algorithm to encode and decode data

question: What is quadrature binary phase shift keying (QBPSK)?
options: A modulation technique that maps binary data onto the imaginary (Q) axis
A prioritized QoS mechanism used for updating the network allocation vector (NAV)
A function that hashes various inputs and derives a pseudorandom value
A channel of operation for all stations in a basic service set (BSS)
correct_answer: A modulation technique that maps binary data onto the imaginary (Q) axis

question: What is the Duration/ID field value in an NDP Ack frame with the Idle Indication field equal to 1? [IEEE 802.11]
options: Duration required for the STA to wait before transmitting the NDP Ack frame
Duration required to transmit the NDP Ack frame
Duration required to transmit an idle period
Duration of time expected from the STA that elicited the response
Duration required for the STA to silence its transmission after the NDP Ack frame
correct_answer: Duration of time expected from the STA that elicited the response

question: In an enhanced active scan with an Enhanced Beacon Request, when should a DSME beacon respond? [IEEE 802.15.4]
options: When the Access method indicates timeslot-based channel access
As soon as possible after receiving the request
When the Access method indicates slotted CSMA-CA
When the Access method indicates unslotted CSMA-CA
At the beginning of the next beacon interval
correct_answer: At the beginning of the next beacon interval

question: Does the 3GPP PS Data Off status affect data transfer over non-3GPP access? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Yes, it completely blocks data transfer over non-3GPP access.
No, it has no impact on data transfer over non-3GPP access.
It depends on the specific services being used.
It depends on the type of non-3GPP access.
correct_answer: No, it has no impact on data transfer over non-3GPP access.

question: What is the purpose of the PUCCH transmission with a link recovery request (LRR)? [3GPP Release 17]
options: To request a link recovery from the network.
To transmit PUCCH on a different cell than the PRACH transmission.
To indicate the presence of periodic CSI-RS configuration or SS/PBCH block.
To monitor PDCCH in all CORESETs on the SCell(s).
correct_answer: To request a link recovery from the network.

question: What does the Timing Delta MAC CE indicate to an IAB-node? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Time difference between DU transmission and IAB-MT reception
Time difference between IAB-MT reception and transmission
Timing advance offset value for a serving cell
Timing Case Indication for a serving cell
correct_answer: Time difference between DU transmission and IAB-MT reception

question: What does STA B do on receiving the sounding PPDU from STA A? [IEEE 802.11]
options: Computes steering matrices and sends a steered PPDU back to STA A.
Switches antennas and computes steering matrices.
Updates its steering vectors and sends a CSI frame to STA A.
Restarts the sequence by returning to step a) if the steering vectors are deemed stale due to delay.
correct_answer: Computes steering matrices and sends a steered PPDU back to STA A.

question: What is the purpose of Bandwidth Adaptation (BA)? [3GPP Release 18]
options: To adjust the width, location, and subcarrier spacing of the UE's receive and transmit bandwidth
To compress and decompress headers
To map QoS flows to data radio bearers
To multiplex and demultiplex MAC SDUs
correct_answer: To adjust the width, location, and subcarrier spacing of the UE's receive and transmit bandwidth

question: What is the maximum inter-site distance supported by the 5G system for a stand-alone multicast/broadcast network? [3GPP Release 17]
options: 50 km
100 km
200 km
250 km
500 km
correct_answer: 200 km

question: What is the maximum number of UEs that an RSU can communicate with according to requirement R.5.1-022? [3GPP Release 17]
options: 50 UEs
100 UEs
150 UEs
200 UEs
250 UEs
correct_answer: 200 UEs

question: What is a fast basic service set (BSS) transition?
options: Change of association from one BSS to another BSS within the same ESS
Change of association from one BSS to another BSS in a different ESS
Change of association from one channel to another channel
Change of association between STAs in a wireless network
Change of association between a fixed STA and a specific location
correct_answer: Change of association from one BSS to another BSS within the same ESS

question: According to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) regulations, what is the non-occupancy period if a radar signal is detected?
options: 10 minutes
20 minutes
30 minutes
40 minutes
50 minutes
correct_answer: 30 minutes

question: What are the two types of reference points for SAN type 1-H? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Radiated and conducted reference points
Operating band specific radiated interface and conducted reference points
Transceiver array boundary and satellite payload
Radio distribution network and antenna array
correct_answer: Radiated and conducted reference points

question: What is the purpose of the prohibit timer in the network? [3GPP Release 14]
options: To trigger SR counters
To perform rate adaptation
To limit frequent query messages
To enable CSFB
To configure bundle frequency hopping
correct_answer: To limit frequent query messages

question: Which TSGs are responsible for the definition of terminals, interfaces, and capabilities?
options: Radio Access Network (RAN) TSGs
Service and System Aspects (SA) TSGs
Core Network and Terminals (CT) TSGs
CT WG 1
RAN WG 1
correct_answer: Core Network and Terminals (CT) TSGs

question: Which IP address range belongs to Class C networks? [TCP/IP]
How does a non-supporting UE select a core network operator to serve it in a shared network? [3GPP Release 17]
options: The UE selects an operator from the available CN operators.
The shared network selects an operator for the UE.
The RAN routes the UE to an available CN node.
The BSC/RNC/eNodeB relays the chosen operator to the core network node.
correct_answer: The shared network selects an operator for the UE.

question: What is the definition of User in the context of 3GPP System?
options: A physically secure device used for accessing services provided by mobile networks
A radio interface between UTRAN and the User Equipment
An entity, not part of the 3GPP System, which uses 3GPP System services
A unidirectional radio link for the transmission of signals from a UE to a base station
A set of actions taken by the network to monitor and control the offered traffic
correct_answer: An entity, not part of the 3GPP System, which uses 3GPP System services

question: What resources are released when a PDU (Protocol Data Unit) session is released?
options: Allocated IP address and UPF resources only
UPF resources and RAN resources only
Allocated IP address, UPF resources, and RAN resources
UPF resources only
Allocated IP address only
correct_answer: Allocated IP address, UPF resources, and RAN resources

question: What does the 'Request-response' communication paradigm involve in management service interactions? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Streaming management data over an established connection
Requesting a subscription to receive network events
Authenticating the management service consumer
Invoking an operation and providing a response
Establishing a connection for management data streaming
correct_answer: Invoking an operation and providing a response

question: What is the purpose of the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message in the UE Initial Access procedure? [3GPP Release 17]
options: To request the setup of the bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP
To initiate the signalling flow for UE Initial access
To allocate F1-U UL TEID and transport layer address
To send the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message to the gNB-CU-CP
correct_answer: To request the setup of the bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP

question: What functions are included in the Online Charging System (OCS)? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Online Charging Function (OCF) and Account Balance Management Function (ABMF)
Charging Trigger Function (CTF) and Charging Data Function (CDF)
Charging Trigger Function (CTF) and Charging Gateway Function (CGF)
Session Based Charging Function (SBCF) and Event Based Charging Function (EBCF)
Charging Data Function (CDF) and Rating Function (RF)
correct_answer: Online Charging Function (OCF) and Account Balance Management Function (ABMF)

question: What does the second frame in a shared-key authentication exchange serve as? [IEEE 802.11]
options: An authentication request denial
A challenge
A response to the challenge
An indication of successful authentication
correct_answer: A challenge
